resources.string: Set your unblock password
You will type this password to change rules or end a block early. Enter it twice. It is stored as a one-way hash on this device and is never sent anywhere.
Hand the phone to your friend
Give the phone to the person who will hold your unblock password. They enter it twice below. You will not see the value, and the app will only record that a friend set it. Do not watch the screen.
Change the unblock password
Enter the current password, then the new one twice. The current password is required: there is no recovery without it.
Current password
New password
Enter it again
Save password
There is no recovery. If this password is lost, the only way past it is to clear the app data, which also erases your rules. This is deliberate: the password is a commitment device, not a jail.
The two entries do not match. Try again.
Use at least %1$d characters.
Use no more than %1$d characters.
A password is already set. Use Change password instead.
That current password is not correct.
No password is set yet.
The credential store is unavailable on this device, so the password was not saved. The saved value is unchanged.
Password saved. Keep it somewhere you can reach when you need it.
Password saved. Your friend holds it.
Password changed.
